# agyn_organization (Resource)

Manages an Agyn organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "agyn_organization" "example" {
  name = "example-org"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Organization name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID identifier of the organization.
